reviews.author: Danielle Williams
reviews.text: Bennito and his crew are the best !! I called him with no idea of what I wanted , and he came through like a true professional giving my landscaping back life! He went out of his way to ensure I was happy ! Very professional and reliable service ! 10 stars!

reviews.author: Cecvister
reviews.text: I hired them to trim a very tall buttonwood hedge. The owner came out, gave me a reasonable quote and was cutting the trees 3 days later. They did an excellent job. Cleaned up everything, moved furniture, put everything back in its place. I couldn't be happier. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Enuka Joseph
reviews.text: B&B landscaping was so professional and they did an amazing job! The price was just right and the workers were respectful and very helpful. They really did a good job cleaning out my yard. I was so pleased and would recommend them every [truncated by Google UI]

reviews.author: Valeria Busciolano
reviews.text: Benito and his crew did a wonderful job! They were professional, fast and affordable. He gave us some great suggestions and we are very happy with the outcome. [truncated by Google UI]

reviews.author: arik cohen
reviews.text: The best and most honest landscaping service I've ever had. After four gardeners who overcharged and did half the work, I was exhausted [truncated by Google UI]
